scenarios.title: Active controller owns the simulated field
scenarios.expected: ctrl-a reports role active and its monitor serves a telemetry snapshot
observations: GET /snapshot returned a telemetry snapshot with tick advancing

evidence.detail: tick advanced from 12 to 47 across the observation window

scenarios.title: Standby converges behind the active
scenarios.expected: ctrl-b reports role standby with tracking converged
observations: GET /role on ctrl-b reported role=standby tracking=converged

scenarios.title: Writable point command applies at a scan boundary
scenarios.expected: POST /command marking pump-1 out-of-service is accepted and visible in telemetry
observations: POST /command accepted with a command receipt
pump-1 oos point read true in the following snapshot

scenarios.title: Demote/promote switchover preserves the field
scenarios.expected: POST /demote on ctrl-a then POST /promote on ctrl-b leaves ctrl-b active and telemetry flowing
observations: snapshot tick continued advancing on ctrl-b

capability_limitations.detail: Controller has no EtherCAT driver; all field I/O exercised through the dcs-sim-net remote simulation only.

timeline.detail: controller and plant images built from pinned source
plant plus redundant controller pair healthy
